facts.business: City Online Services Limited provides internet and broadband services.

auditor.name: Komandoor & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Net worth completely eroded (Negative Networth Rs. 54.72 Lakhs as on 31st March 2026) indicating material uncertainty on going concern; 2) Revenue underreporting in GST returns by Rs. 42.06 Lakhs; 3) Discrepancy in input tax credit (CGST overstated Rs. 2.13 lakhs, SGST overstated Rs. 2.26 lakhs, IGST understated Rs. 0.69 lakhs); 4) Unbilled revenue of Rs. 18.88 lakhs; 5) Non-recognition of Expected Credit Loss per Ind AS 109; 6) Loans to related party (Rs. 15.51 lakhs outstanding) exceeding Section 186 limits without requisite approvals. Emphasis of Matter: 1) Reconciliation of expired/fully depreciated PPE; 2) Trade receivables (Rs. 83.15 Lakhs) subject to confirmation; 3) Trade payables (Rs. 220.54 Lakhs) subject to confirmation; 4) Process of identifying MSME creditors and ageing.

key_risks: Material uncertainty on going concern due to negative net worth (Rs. 54.72 Lakhs) and cash losses
Revenue underreporting in GST returns (Rs. 42.06 Lakhs)
Non-compliance with Section 186 for related party loans (Rs. 15.51 Lakhs) without shareholder/board approvals
Non-recognition of Expected Credit Loss on financial assets per Ind AS 109
Trade receivables (Rs. 83.15 Lakhs) and payables (Rs. 220.54 Lakhs) subject to confirmation/reconciliation
Deficiencies in fixed asset records for expired/fully depreciated assets
Proposed sale/divestment of business/undertaking subject to approvals with no definitive agreement yet
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business. No material significant transactions with potential conflict. Loans granted to related party amounting to Rs. 0.54 Lakhs during the year, aggregating to Rs. 15.51 Lakhs outstanding as at balance sheet date, exceeding Section 186 limits without requisite approvals. Details in Note 37 to financial statements per IND AS-24 and Form AOC-2 (Annexure-1).
